name: Zscaler blocked malware or threat download
author: Sentra SOC
description: Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA via on-prem NSS, CEF) blocked a web request carrying a threat (malware / threat-category hit): the SWG stopped a drive-by or malicious download. fields.vendor_hook=zscaler, action=blocked and a threat name present.

name: Zscaler repeated policy bypass attempts by one user
author: Sentra SOC
description: 20 or more Zscaler web requests blocked by policy for one user within 10 minutes - a user repeatedly trying to reach blocked categories / an anonymiser or proxy-avoidance tool to bypass the SWG.

name: Zscaler DLP-triggered web upload blocked
author: Sentra SOC
description: Zscaler blocked a web upload that matched a DLP engine / dictionary (fields.zscaler_dlp present, action=blocked) - an attempted exfiltration to a web / cloud destination stopped by the SWG DLP.

name: Zscaler allowed traffic to a risky category
author: Sentra SOC
description: Zscaler ALLOWED a web / firewall session whose URL or application category is high-risk (anonymiser, proxy avoidance, botnet / C2, malware or phishing site, cryptomining, newly-registered domain, remote-access or peer-to-peer). Anomalous allowed traffic to a risky category that the policy did not block.
